reponse: The migration plan set production cutover for Saturday Nov 21, 02:00–06:00 UTC [1], with the same date in the tracking ticket and a customer maintenance notice for Nov 21 [4][3]. That date has since moved: after the Dec 11 ingest incident a second dry run was requested and the cutover was rescheduled to Saturday Nov 28, same window [2], and an infra PR moves the window to 2026-11-28, plan only, not applied [6]. So the latest evidence points to Nov 28 [2][6], contradicting the earlier Nov 21 date [1].
